{"code":"local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
  attacker = attacker or {}
  defender = defender or {}
  skill = skill or {}
  local atk = attacker.atk
  local alevel = attacker.level
  local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0

  local hp = defender.hp
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor
  local dlevel = defender.level
  local delement = defender.element or 'neutral'
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding and true or false

  local power = skill.power
  local selement = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local true_damage = skill.true_damage and true or false
  local seed = skill.seed or 0

  local mult = {
    physical = {fire=100, water=100, nature=100, neutral=100, ghost=0},
    fire = {fire=50, water=50, nature=200, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    water = {fire=200, water=50, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    nature = {fire=50, water=200, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100}
  }

  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false

  for k = 1, hits do
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local p = math.max(10, power - 20*(k-1))
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)

    local diff = alevel - dlevel
    if diff > 10 then diff = 10 elseif diff < -10 then diff = -10 end
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3*diff) / 100)

    local crit = ((seed + 17*k) % 100) < crit_chance
    if crit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
    end

    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))

      local m = 100
      local row = mult[selement]
      if row and row[delement] ~= nil then m = row[delement] end
      if m == 0 then immune = true end
      d = math.floor(d * m / 100)

      local r = resist[selement] or 0
      if r > 80 then r = 80 elseif r < -50 then r = -50 end
      d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    end

    if guarding then d = math.floor(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 and not immune then d = 1 end

    local a = math.min(shield, d)
    shield = shield - a
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then
      loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100)
    end

    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
      break
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end

  return {
    damage = defender.hp - hp,
    absorbed = absorbed,
    hp = hp,
    shield = shield,
    overkill = overkill,
    crits = crits,
    hits = resolved,
    killed = killed
  }
end

local ra1 = {atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5}
local rd1 = {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false}
local rs1 = {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3}
local r1 = resolve_attack(ra1, rd1, rs1)
local r1b = resolve_attack(ra1, rd1, rs1)

local ra2 = {atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10}
local rd2 = {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true}
local rs2 = {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40}
local r2 = resolve_attack(ra2, rd2, rs2)

local function fmt(r)
  return '{damage='..r.damage..', absorbed='..r.absorbed..', hp='..r.hp..', shield='..r.shield..', overkill='..r.overkill..', crits='..r.crits..', hits='..r.hits..', killed='..tostring(r.killed)..'}'
end
return 'E1='..fmt(r1)..' | E1again='..fmt(r1b)..' | E2='..fmt(r2)
"}

  if result > max_hp then result = max_hp end
  if result < 0 then result = 0 end
  return result

{"code":"logic_define('wave_reward', function(n)
  n = math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0)
  if n <= 0 then return 0 end
  if n <= 2 then return 1 end
  local a, b = 1, 1
  for i = 3, n do
    a, b = b, a + b
  end
  return b
end)
